meta.title: Hebrew Keyboard
meta.description: Easily type in Hebrew with our Hebrew keyboard - perfect for typing using the אלפבית עברי.

faqs.question: How do I use this online Hebrew keyboard?
faqs.answer: Click or tap any key to insert its Hebrew character into the text box, or type directly on your physical QWERTY keyboard and the matching Hebrew letters will appear. Once you're done, copy the text to use it anywhere you need Hebrew.

faqs.question: What layout does this Hebrew keyboard use?
faqs.answer: This keyboard uses the SI-1452 standard Hebrew layout, the official Israeli standard, mapped onto a QWERTY keyboard.

faqs.question: Why are the bracket keys swapped?
faqs.answer: On the standard Hebrew layout, punctuation like brackets follows logical rather than physical order, so they render mirrored to display correctly in right-to-left text.

faqs.question: Can I type Hebrew using my QWERTY keyboard?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can type using your regular QWERTY keyboard and the on-screen Hebrew keyboard will display the matching Hebrew character for each key.
